newsitem.title: ITALY: Privatisation of airports an irreversible trend.
newsitem.headline: Privatisation of airports an irreversible trend.

text.p: Privatisation of airport managing companies is an irreversible trend, said Niels Boserup, ACI Europe President.

Speaking at a conference, held at Leonardo da Vinci Airport in Rome, Boserup said Rome will be the fourth airport to be privatised after London, Copenhagen and Vienna, which is ahead of Amsterdam, Frankfurt and Paris.

Commenting on airport duties, Boserup said that duties are a very important source for the financing of infrastructural development and he would hope that there will be harmonisation in the pricing policy concerning this in all countries.
He added that he was awaiting European Union instruction on the matter.
Airports should also be more involved in land-use planning in the regions surrounding airports, he said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
